name: French Valley Village Center

description: French Valley Village Center is a thriving neighborhood shopping destination strategically located on Benton Road in Winchester, California, serving the rapidly growing French Valley community in the Riverside-San Bernardino-Ontario market. This 113,928 square foot community center benefits from exceptional visibility and accessibility along the main thoroughfare, making it a convenient daily stop for the area's affluent residents. Anchored by trusted household names including CVS Pharmacy and Stater Brothers supermarket, the center provides essential goods and services that draw over 3.3 million visits annually. The property is professionally managed by Regency Centers, a nationally recognized shopping center developer and operator known for creating best-in-class retail environments. With strong residential growth surrounding the center and a trade area characterized by high household incomes exceeding $157,000 and home values over $713,000, French Valley Village Center serves as a vital community hub for one of Southern California's most desirable suburban markets.
